test_sim_predicates: test SimBasedPredicates spatial and state predicates like is_inside, is_on_floor, is_in_room against a Habitat simulator episode
test_proposition_dependencies: test proposition dependency relations like while_satisfied and after_satisfied to determine which propositions to evaluate at each timestep
test_evaluation_constraints: test TemporalConstraint, SameArgConstraint, DifferentArgConstraint, and TerminalSatisfactionConstraint for validating task completion sequences
test_apply_constraint_satisfaction: test apply_constraint_satisfaction to check if a state sequence satisfies all evaluation constraints and compute percent complete
test_evaluation_explanation: test derive_evaluation_explanation to generate human-readable failure explanations for unsatisfied propositions and violated constraints
